title: 'Tattoo (Remix)' Music Video Passes One Billion YouTube Views
summary:
The music video for "Tattoo (Remix)" by Rauw Alejandro and Camilo has joined YouTube's Billion Views Club, according to Billboard. That means the video has now been watched more than one billion times.

Alejandro, a singer from Puerto Rico, first released the song "Tattoo" in February 2020. By July of that same year, he shared a new pop-style version on YouTube featuring Camilo, a singer and songwriter from Colombia. It was the first time the two Latin music artists had worked together.

The song is in the reggaeton style, a type of music with Latin and Caribbean roots. Its video shows the two singers spending a fun day out with friends on Miami Beach in Florida.

Fans loved the remix, and it got a big boost from a TikTok challenge using the hashtag #TattooChallenge. As the trend spread, the song climbed to number one on two Billboard charts that track how often Latin songs are played on the radio, the Latin Airplay and Latin Rhythm Airplay charts. Six years after its release, the video has now reached the billion-view mark.

The song was produced by a team called Los Honeyboos and Mr. Nais Gai and was written by a group of songwriters that included Alejandro and Camilo.

Alejandro has had 13 songs on the Billboard Hot 100 chart and 88 on Billboard's Hot Latin Songs chart. "Tattoo" reached number seven on that Latin chart, one of his 17 top 10 songs there. Camilo has had 21 songs on the Hot Latin Songs chart, including two top 10 hits.

Alejandro has stayed busy. Last month, he performed several shows at Forest Hills Stadium in Queens, New York, telling the story of his musical roots.
why_it_matters: The milestone shows how a song can keep finding new fans for years through online videos and social media challenges.

keywords.explanation: A remix is a new version of a song made by changing or adding to the original.
Reggaeton is a style of dance music with Latin and Caribbean roots.
A hashtag is a word or phrase after a # sign that groups posts about the same topic online.
Music charts are ranked lists that show which songs are most popular.
Produced means guided the recording of a song and shaped how it sounds.
